tasks.short: Report inspection findings and explain corrective action

steps.what: Establish findings and recommendations and capture their evidence references
Populate reports from inspector supplied fields without interpreting their meaning
Check reports, approve recommendations and advise recipients about corrective action

tasks.design: Configure a fixed report template in {DOCS}. It places inspector authored findings and recommendations into the report; the inspector checks and issues it and explains action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Findings were recopied into recurring report sections.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates can place supplied fields without generating safety conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing and defending proportionate corrective action.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector relates observations to conditions on the premises and answers objections.
tasks.altitude: Own the quality of evidence and corrective recommendations.

reach.learn: Translate inspection reasoning into practical instructions

evidence.claim: Fixed templates can assemble supplied fields; the labour scenario is unmeasured model knowledge.

assumptions: Inspection itself is outside this reporting task and earns no savings here.
In s1 the inspector produces site identity, visit date, evidence references, exact finding wording and exact recommendation wording; capture and missing field resolution are included in its 35 hours.
Native templates are tried first; missing fields or unusual reports revert to manual composition, with no inferred compliance code.
No recommendation is generated by the template.
unknowns: Share of reports fitting one fixed form
research_questions: Does total field capture, checking and explanation time fall on ordinary reports?

already_counted.description: Finding capture, report review and recipient discussion

incremental.description: Template maintenance and sampled output checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact report version, evidence references, recommendations and recipient; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenarios: B=100, R=75 gives 25 gross and 18 net after 7 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-4 allows limited template fit and extra capture; advice remains full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Collect samples using suitable identification and contamination controls
Package samples, complete custody details and arrange laboratory handover

tasks.design: Keep collection, packaging and custody handover with the inspector. No digital step is assumed to replace specimen handling.
tasks.previous_blocker: Biological materials require physical selection and controlled handling.
tasks.enabler_now: None established for removing the work named in this task.
tasks.still_hard: Collecting representative material without compromising test validity.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise unsuitable samples and adapt collection technique.
tasks.altitude: Improve sample integrity rather than promise software labour savings.

evidence.claim: Digital records do not perform specimen collection or physical custody handover; no labour reduction is established here.

assumptions: The inspector records sample identity, source, collection time and required handling conditions in s1; s2 includes custody entries, packaging checks, recipient confirmation and handover.
The receiving laboratory supplies submission requirements before packaging; resolving missing instructions remains in s2.
Laboratory analysis is outside this task; no new service or automation is deployed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Transport and preservation requirements for each sample type
research_questions: Which custody defects cause recollection in current practice?

incremental.description: No changed workflow or software upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100: physical handling and custody capture remain; zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise on agricultural equipment, layouts and food safety systems

steps.what: Provide consultative services after clarifying site conditions, proposed equipment and safety concerns

tasks.design: Retain consultation as a professional conversation. Clarification of site constraints and explanation of recommendations remain part of the task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful advice depends on the actual process and the operator's understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: No task specific automation gain is established.
tasks.still_hard: Relating general requirements to a particular physical layout or process.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge assumptions and explain workable alternatives.
tasks.altitude: Strengthen consultation quality through better questions.

reach.learn: Describe operating constraints and safety concerns

evidence.claim: Contextual equipment and food safety advice requires professional judgement; no measured saving is available for this task.

assumptions: The operator supplies the question and proposal; the inspector obtains missing details during s1, with all clarification time retained.
No prevalidated layout, risk code or equipment suitability flag is assumed.
No added preparation task is invented; the unchanged conversation introduces no upkeep.
unknowns: Typical question complexity and available site information

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: the consultation remains fully human; no gross or net saving claimed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect food products and processing safety

steps.what: Inspect products and processing procedures and determine whether evidence supports food safety

tasks.design: Keep direct inspection and the safety determination with the inspector. Software is not treated as a producer of a safe to eat flag.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safety depends on physical conditions and evidence that may be incomplete.
tasks.enabler_now: None established for replacing inspection judgement in this task.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising hazards that routine checks miss.
tasks.human_edge: Evaluate conflicting observations and escalate uncertainty.
tasks.altitude: Improve inspection reasoning and escalation quality.

reach.learn: Escalate concerns without treating appearance as proof of safety

evidence.claim: Physical inspection and safety judgement are retained; the digest does not establish automated food safety determinations.

assumptions: The inspector produces the findings and uncertainty assessment during s1; observation and any necessary clarification are included.
Report writing and sampling are separate tasks and earn no savings in this inspection task.
No deployment or added monitoring is proposed, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Applicable product specific criteria and inspection methods
research_questions: Which observations require specialist follow up before a safety conclusion?

incremental.description: No additional system or operating work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: all inspection judgement remains, with zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Protect inspection judgement while removing repeated report formatting where a fixed form fits.
reach: Help supervisors explain corrective actions and preserve sample integrity
role.ambitious_version: An inspector who spends less effort formatting findings and retains time for field assessment and operator advice.
